## WebRtcClient.startLiveStream() method

Starts a live stream using WebRTC.

Note: If audio is requested it will start playback with mute=true and volume=0.0

**Signature:**

```typescript
startLiveStream(options: LiveStreamOptions): Promise<WebRtcLiveStreamContext>;
```
